about: Every source the overview page reads, in one place. Each entry names its section, the source_policy.json role that grants it, its root (repo or state), one exact path or one glob, what the page reads from it and the trigger that makes a pending source present. To move a record, change its path or glob here and the matching grant in source_policy.json; the generator needs no change. A glob reads the newest match by name. A missing source renders as pending with its trigger.

final_stack.reads: layers[] (catalog, layer_id, title, status, winners, survivors) and runs[] (id, pin); the layer states and FINAL count follow tools/local-pages/architecture_manifest.py layer_state()
final_stack.trigger: scripts/final_stack.py writes the file at a merged commit

foundation_catalog.reads: layers[] order and titles of the foundation catalog
foundation_catalog.trigger: the foundation landscape catalog is committed

trading_catalog.reads: layers[] order and titles of the us-equities trading catalog
trading_catalog.trigger: the us-equities landscape catalog is committed

evidence_matrix.reads: rows[] host E2E state and invoke evidence, for the four FINAL conditions
evidence_matrix.trigger: the component evidence matrix is committed

feeds_convergence.reads: a sanitized projection: under the heading below, the table with the column below and its item's lead as caption; the numbered items whose leads name each point phrase; and, under the gaps heading, the bullets whose leads start with the gap word. Any sentence that cites a path, digest or line, or names a drop term, is withheld
feeds_convergence.trigger: the command center records its WS2 convergence after both blind judges have scored the arms

feeds_addendum.reads: a sanitized projection of the newest addendum to the convergence record shown: under the heading below, each top-level bullet of the form 'subject: result', as its subject (the parenthesised one, if any) and the sentences of it and its nested bullets that name a result word below. A parenthesised citation of a path, digest or line is dropped; any other sentence that cites one, or names a drop term, is withheld
feeds_addendum.trigger: the command center records entitlement measurements as an addendum to the WS2 convergence record

feeds_battery.reads: presence only: until it exists the feeds section states the statement below; then it cites the record by name
feeds_battery.label: Measured battery result
feeds_battery.trigger: the frozen all-flag battery reports measured earliness, precision and all-flag returns on the development and validation windows

strategies_convergence.reads: a sanitized projection of the numbered items under the heading below: the item whose lead names the family word, with the clauses that name a caveat word; the list that follows the text naming the ablations word; and the rows of the item whose lead names the sizing word. Any sentence that cites a path, digest or line, or names a drop term, is withheld
strategies_convergence.trigger: the command center records its WS5 convergence of the extreme-mover strategy shortlist

strategies_replication.reads: presence only: until it exists the strategies section states the statement below; then it cites the record by name
strategies_replication.label: Replication record
strategies_replication.trigger: the trading program records the frozen, costed replication of the shortlisted family

finalize_rows.reads: the table whose header names the key column below; per layer, the columns below
finalize_rows.trigger: the command center writes the finalize-all rows for every layer

finalize_plan.reads: each wave paragraph opening with a bold 'F<n>. <title>.' lead: its id, its title and the first sentence after the trigger word below
finalize_plan.trigger: the command center writes its finalize-all plan

finalize_f1.reads: the arm list: each arm's result (success true or false where a receipt exists, otherwise its state), counted by result
finalize_f1.trigger: the co-op publishes the F1 receipt index

finalize_f2.reads: presence, and per second-level heading (without its parenthesised aside) a count: the rows of its first table, otherwise its entries that open with a bold lead
finalize_f2.trigger: cc-native-practice records the Claude side of F2

registered_receipts.reads: receipts[] (path, component_ids); a worker's newest receipt is the registered receipt with the latest date in its path
registered_receipts.trigger: a receipt is registered with scripts/host_receipts.py

runtime_profiles.reads: status and tool_read_utc of the pi and OpenCode profile qualification
runtime_profiles.trigger: the runtime-profile qualification receipt is committed

cc_floor_prep.reads: under the heading below, the first version and the first 40-character commit: the proposed run pin, shown as proposed until the claude-code run in final-stack.json carries that version
cc_floor_prep.under: Source commit for the run pin
cc_floor_prep.trigger: cc-native-practice prepares the next Claude Code floor and run pin

cc_changelog.reads: per version heading: the version, the count of entries opening with each kind below (others counted together), and at most the item limit of short items, taken from the first kinds in order
cc_changelog.trigger: cc-native-practice cuts the CHANGELOG delta for the next floor

cc_slots.reads: client_version, status_values and slots[] (id, status, default, client_version where a slot carries its own), one row per slot with the default cut to its first clause
cc_slots.trigger: the claude-native-practice skill commits its slot table

cc_now.reads: updated_utc, in_review[] (pr, head, state, next_gate), landing_queue[], main_ci and api_credit (routing, read_utc), schema cc-now/1
cc_now.trigger: the command center publishes its current view

feeds_arms.reads: the arm table: per row the arm (the worker) and the model named in its route or notes cells, or 'not stated'; no route text, path or run id is shown
feeds_arms.label: WS2 data feeds for early entry
feeds_arms.trigger: the co-op records the WS2 arm reports

strategies_arms.reads: the arm table: per row the arm (the worker) and the model named in its route or notes cells, or 'not stated'; no route text, path or run id is shown
strategies_arms.label: WS5 extreme-mover strategies
strategies_arms.trigger: the co-op records the WS5 arm reports
